title: The Sunwright
changes: Act 2's final quest: at Lv 46, Sefa sends you up the Furnace Stair to stop Ishael, the Sunwright, before she lights a second sun over the desert.
She talks through the fight. She fires a lance of sunlight along a marked line, bursts into flame when you crowd her, and drops molten sun where you stand.
Below 65% her Veiled choir comes to sing for her and she calls ZENITH: the whole plateau burns except her own shadow, hotter for every adept still singing. Kill the choir, then stand close to her.
Below 30% she becomes the Second Sun: bigger, faster, and the sun falls twice as often.
Monsters no longer wander onto the Furnace plateau, and the beast-folk's moves no longer show a stray "CLEAVE!" mark.
